correctness.rationale: For every n>=6 (also n=5), face F of Ind_2(KG(n,2)) consists of ground-set pairs each disjoint from at most one other selected pair. H(F) excluding base point 0 is either pairwise-intersecting A or contains a disjoint pair B. In A each H is star, triangle or empty, and toggling a distinguished 0i gives legal complete fiber matching. In B a disjoint pair uses a unique four-set U, all other pairs meet both and lie inside U, with no 0-edge; the six possible U edges decompose into three matching pairs, yielding exactly 37 admissible upper-filter faces. Independently constructed all 37, performed three pivot matchings (14,3,1 pairs), found one critical four-edge face, and verified complete Hasse acyclicity. The fiber patchwork map is order-preserving and B_U incomparable; hence a global acyclic matching with binom(n-1,4) critical dimension-3 cells and paired augmented empty face. Standard Morse reduction gives a basepoint and no 1- or 2-cells, so attaching maps are trivial and the space is a wedge of that many S3, not merely finite Betti evidence.
residual_risks: Computational corroboration is restricted to the stated finite class; it is not a general numerical experiment proof.
